entries.headline: TV-buying craze sweeps Metropolis as new model debuts
entries.description: An aggressive launch campaign by an unnamed retailer (and three suspiciously well-dressed influencers) has Metropolis household electronics flying off shelves.

entries.headline: Bumper cotton harvest crashes textile feedstock prices
entries.description: Favourable rains and a quiet pest season produced an exceptional cotton crop. Apparel makers expect cheaper denim and tee runs through year-end.

entries.headline: Viral ad campaign boosts soft-drink awareness in Metropolis
entries.description: A 30-second spot picked up unexpected social-media traction overnight. Brand recall for soft drinks across Metropolis got a lift across all incumbents.
